allowedValues.name: public
allowedValues.description: Publicly available; no ePHI, no PII

allowedValues.name: internal
allowedValues.description: Internal use; no ePHI; may contain internal docs/designs

allowedValues.name: synthetic
allowedValues.description: Synthetic test data (Synthea fixtures, mock patients); never real ePHI

allowedValues.name: phi-capable
allowedValues.description: Can process ePHI in principle (e.g., FHIR API framework); not actively used for ePHI today

allowedValues.name: phi-active
allowedValues.description: Actively processes/stores real ePHI in production

allowedValues.name: experimental
allowedValues.description: Research, prototype, proof-of-concept; not used clinically

allowedValues.name: reference
allowedValues.description: Reference implementation, educational, documentation; not used in clinical decisions

allowedValues.name: clinical-support
allowedValues.description: Supports clinical workflows (e.g., patient data portal, charting UX); non-critical to patient care

allowedValues.name: clinical-decision
allowedValues.description: Clinical decision support (CDS); impacts patient diagnosis/treatment decisions

allowedValues.name: device
allowedValues.description: Medical device software or SaMD; directly impacts patient care/safety

properties.name: iec62304-class
properties.description: IEC 62304 software safety classification (medical devices only)

allowedValues.name: not-applicable
allowedValues.description: Not a medical device; IEC 62304 not applicable

allowedValues.name: class-a
allowedValues.description: Class A: No injury possible (display-only, informational)

allowedValues.name: class-b
allowedValues.description: Class B: Non-serious injury possible (e.g., dose calculation, alarms)

allowedValues.name: class-c
allowedValues.description: Class C: Death or serious injury possible (e.g., infusion, ventilation)

properties.name: regulated
properties.description: Is this software subject to regulatory oversight (FDA, EMA, etc.)?

allowedValues.name: julia
allowedValues.description: Julia (scientific computing, simulations)

allowedValues.name: rust
allowedValues.description: Rust (systems, performance-critical, medical devices)

allowedValues.name: node
allowedValues.description: Node.js / TypeScript (web, API)

allowedValues.name: python
allowedValues.description: Python (data science, scripting, analysis)

allowedValues.name: go
allowedValues.description: Go (services, tools, microservices)

allowedValues.name: content
allowedValues.description: Content (docs, education, markdown-based)

allowedValues.name: polyglot
allowedValues.description: Multiple languages / monorepo

properties.name: baa-required
properties.description: Does this repo/service require a Business Associate Agreement (HIPAA BAA)?

metadata.instructions: Upload these properties via: Organization Settings → Repository → Custom properties. Add each property with the specified type and allowed values.
